items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...We've got the drums. Harrison Brass. I'm talking about it.

ctx.x: Yeah, you was there on that one.

Yeah, that's another one of Crawford's. That's one we took. You were 18 of that? Apex apartment where Bradley was living. Yes, right. 1600 block of Robertson. Robertson, yeah. Yeah. And let's see. We've got George Henderson. We've got the drums. Harrison Brass. I'm talking about it. Deion Trumpet. Melee Barnes there. Clarenette. And they got you there, standing there. And that's Glenny. And... Amy Raleigh. Now, what's that... That's...
What's that boy used to ride a cornfield guitar? What's his name? Forche. Huh? Forche. Yeah, Forche.
